return_text:
As of **2026-09-24**, these are ranked **benchmark candidates**. I found no evidence establishing a universal winner or guaranteed 20-second completion on this Mac. Scores below are **vendor/author-reported**, not independently reproduced; different benchmark protocols are not directly comparable.

**1. Text embeddings**

1. **Nemotron-3-Embed-8B-BF16 — NVIDIA; strongest quality challenger.** Released **2026-07-16**; **8B, OpenMDW-1.1, 32,768 tokens**. NVIDIA’s **July 15 leaderboard snapshot** shows first place; its evaluation reports **RTEB16 nDCG@10 78.46**, **MMTEB retrieval 75.45**. [Card](https://huggingface.co/nvidia/Nemotron-3-Embed-8B-BF16), [release/results](https://huggingface.co/blog/nvidia/nemotron-3-embed-wins-rteb). Local: community [`Abiray/Nemotron-3-Embed-8B-GGUF`](https://huggingface.co/Abiray/Nemotron-3-Embed-8B-GGUF), `Nemotron-3-Embed-8B-Q8_0.gguf`; publication date **unverified**.

2. **Nemotron-3-Embed-1B-BF16 — NVIDIA; efficiency challenger.** Released **2026-07-16**; **1.14B, OpenMDW-1.1, 32,768 tokens**. Same evaluation: **RTEB16 72.38**, **MMTEB retrieval 71.04**. The release quotes partner-reported **LongMemEval Retrieval@10 80.38%**; methodology and S variant remain unconfirmed. [Card](https://huggingface.co/nvidia/Nemotron-3-Embed-1B-BF16), [results](https://huggingface.co/blog/nvidia/nemotron-3-embed-wins-rteb). Local: community [`mlx-community/Nemotron-3-Embed-1B-BF16-8bit`](https://huggingface.co/mlx-community/Nemotron-3-Embed-1B-BF16-8bit); publication date **unverified**.

3. **Qwen3-Embedding-8B — Alibaba/Qwen; established deployment control.** Released **2025-06-05**; **8B, Apache-2.0, 32K tokens**. **MMTEB retrieval 70.88**, comparison snapshot **2025-05-24**. [Release](https://qwenlm.github.io/blog/qwen3-embedding/), [card/results](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-8B). Official [`Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-8B-GGUF`](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-8B-GGUF/commits/main/Qwen3-Embedding-8B-Q8_0.gguf): Q8_0 first uploaded **2025-06-05**, replaced **2025-07-15**.

**2. Reranking**

1. **MemReranker-4B — IAAR-Shanghai; closest workload match.** [Official weights](https://huggingface.co/IAAR-Shanghai/MemReranker-4B/commits/main) published **2026-04-27**; **4B, Apache-2.0, 32K base context**, trained at **8,192 tokens**. **May 7 paper snapshot:** LongMemEval **nDCG@10 0.8354**, **MAP 0.8043**, using a fixed top-50 candidate set. [Paper](https://arxiv.org/html/2605.06132v1). Community MLX [`nisavid/MemReranker-4B-OptiQ-4bit`](https://huggingface.co/nisavid/MemReranker-4B-OptiQ-4bit); first publication **unverified**, updated July 11.

2. **Jina Reranker v3.5 — Jina AI; compact listwise candidate.** Released **2026-07-27**; **0.6B, CC-BY-NC-4.0, 131K combined context**. [Specifications](https://jina.ai/models/jina-reranker-v3.5). **August 3 evaluation:** **BEIR nDCG@10 63.20**, **MIRACL 74.11**. [Results](https://jina.ai/news/jina-reranker-v3-5-faster-listwise-reranking-hybrid-attention-self-distillation). Official [`jinaai/jina-reranker-v3.5-mlx`](https://huggingface.co/jinaai/jina-reranker-v3.5-mlx/commits/main) published **2026-07-24**; requires its custom reranking implementation.

3. **Ettin Reranker 400M v1 — Tom Aarsen/Sentence Transformers; Node candidate.** Released **2026-05-19**; **401.6M, Apache-2.0, 8K tokens**. Same-day **MTEB English v2 retrieval nDCG@10 0.6091**, averaged across six retrievers/ten tasks. [Release/results](https://huggingface.co/blog/ettin-reranker). Official [`cross-encoder/ettin-reranker-400m-v1`](https://huggingface.co/cross-encoder/ettin-reranker-400m-v1/commit/6fc3168063f7ab30e071f379bc483859e02a4c87), `onnx/model_qint8_arm64.onnx`, published **May 19**. MLX/GGUF and Transformers.js integration **unverified**.

**3. Consolidation and listwise LLM**

1. **Qwen3.5-9B — Alibaba/Qwen; retain as control.** Released **2026-03-02**; **9B, Apache-2.0, 262,144 native context**, extensible to 1,010,000. **LongBench v2 55.2**; card observed September 24, evaluation date unspecified. This supports long-context processing, not ranking accuracy. [Release history](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3.8/blob/main/README.md), [card](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B). Community [`mlx-community/Qwen3.5-9B-4bit`](https://huggingface.co/mlx-community/Qwen3.5-9B-4bit/commits/main) published **March 2**.

2. **LFM2.5-2.6B — Liquid AI; speed challenger.** Released **2026-08-04**; **2.69B, LFM1.0, 131,072 tokens**. No direct memory/retrieval score found; **IFStruct 85.49** is only a structured-output proxy, card observed September 24. [Release](https://www.liquid.ai/blog/lfm2-5-2-6b), [card](https://huggingface.co/LiquidAI/LFM2.5-2.6B). Official [`LiquidAI/LFM2.5-2.6B-GGUF`](https://huggingface.co/LiquidAI/LFM2.5-2.6B-GGUF/commits/main) published **August 4**; current `LFM2.5-2.6B-Q4_K_M.gguf` uploaded **August 19**.

3. **MemReader-4B-thinking — IAAR-Shanghai; consolidation-only experiment.** [Paper released April 9, 2026](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07877); **4B, Apache-2.0, 40,960 tokens**. **LongMemEval 83.00%** is a whole-pipeline result requiring four memory tools, not standalone summarization/listwise ranking. [Card/results](https://huggingface.co/IAAR-Shanghai/MemReader-4B-thinking/blob/main/README.md). Community [`mradermacher/MemReader-4B-thinking-GGUF`](https://huggingface.co/mradermacher/MemReader-4B-thinking-GGUF); publication date **unverified**.

**Benchmark replacements:** Nemotron 1B challenges your current 0.6B embedder and Node embedding default; Nemotron 8B challenges the 4B/8B embedders. All three rerankers challenge the bundled cross-encoder and current LLM reranking. LFM challenges Qwen3.5-9B for both tasks; MemReader challenges consolidation only. Keep existing models as controls; measure session recall, answer correctness, consolidation fidelity and complete-request p95 latency at 4K/8K.

**Risks:** Jina’s license is noncommercial; Liquid’s is custom. Nemotron needs correct bidirectional attention/pooling; an [unresolved LM Studio report](https://github.com/lmstudio-ai/lmstudio-bug-tracker/issues/2177) documents wrong-dimensional outputs. Specialized rerankers need adapters. Reserve context for queries/templates and entire candidate lists. Liquid always reasons; its [220 tokens/s M5 Max CPU result](https://www.liquid.ai/blog/lfm2-5-2-6b) does not establish M5 Pro prefill or 20-second latency. Local speed and quantized accuracy remain unverified.

The browser permission check denied live Hugging Face leaderboard access; September 24 standings were not verified.
